description: In 2024, the Tennessee General Assembly affirmed a simple but essential principle: parents have the right to access their child’s medical records. That principle was codified in the Family Rights and Responsibilities Act, recognizing that parents are not outsiders in their children’s lives. They are responsible for their care, their safety, and their well-being.
